m01:room.title: The Intake Chemistry House
m01:room.job: Find out if the water at the pumps will be too salty at high tide.

m02:room.title: The Watershed Routing Shed
m02:room.job: Find how much nitrate the first storm flush would carry to the marsh.

m03:room.title: The Oxygen Process Hall
m03:room.job: Find how low the oxygen in the refuge channel will fall by dawn.

m04:room.title: The Marsh Hydraulics Pavilion
m04:room.job: Find which repair plan keeps the waves from spilling over the levee.

m05:room.title: The Contaminant Analysis Lab
m05:room.job: Find the benzene level if Heron Creek mixes into the main channel.

m06:room.title: The Food Web Field House
m06:room.job: Find which crab beds are safe for children to eat from.

m07:room.title: The Population Dynamics Station
m07:room.job: Find out if the boats take more oysters than Grand Reef can grow back.

m08:room.title: The Barrier Ecology Observatory
m08:room.job: Find which habitat link brings back the most species.

m09:room.title: The Soil Recovery Barn
m09:room.job: Find which replanting plan keeps soil loss under the limit.

m10:room.title: The Pump Energy Control Room
m10:room.job: Find which power plan keeps the air on Canal Row under the dust limit.

m11:room.title: The Aquifer Operations Vault
m11:room.job: Find out if the river and the wells can supply the city as it grows.

m12:room.title: The Climate Projection Room
m12:room.job: Find out if the old pump floor will be high enough for thirty years.

m13:room.title: The Field Methods Annex
m13:room.job: Find how much of the nitrate drop the new marsh really made.

m14:room.title: The Estuary Decision Forum
m14:room.job: Find which drainage route meets the permit's limit on exposure.

m15:room.title: The Northgate Command Center
m15:room.job: Find the rate Northgate can reopen at, and the controls to keep.
